newsitem.title: USA: Oryx finds new Seabreeze field reserves.
newsitem.headline: Oryx finds new Seabreeze field reserves.

text.p: Oryx Energy Co said Monday two exploration wells drilled at the Seabreeze field in southeast Texas tested a total of 33 million cubic feet of nautral gas and 1,160 barrels of oil daily.,
"We arfe pleased that new technologies are helping us find previously untapped reserves in our own back yard," said Chief Operating Officer Jerry Box.

The wells were drilled into new fault blocks as a result of a continuing 3-D seismic program around the company's larger onshore fields, it explained. Oryx holds a 100 percent interest in these wells.
The company said it plans to drill two further exploratory tests in the Seabreeze area later this year and has identified additional well locations for 1998.
